name: Webster University Geneva
summary: Geneva campus of the US-based Webster University, teaching in English; BA and BS majors from International Relations to Computer Science.

ib.text: IB Diploma with 24 points (32+ for the Scholars Program). English waived with English A HL 4, English A SL 5, English B HL 5 or English B SL 6, or possibly for an English-medium school.

programmes.name: International Relations
programmes.about: Global politics, human rights, geopolitical tensions and migration, taught minutes from the UN district by professors and practitioners, with guest speakers from international bodies and field trips to Geneva agencies.
programmes.ib: An IB Diploma with 24 points is the estimated minimum; predicted grades are enough for a provisional offer, and IB results can earn up to 32 credits.
programmes.selectionNote: Rolling review by an admissions committee, about 10 days after your file is complete: transcript, a 300-400-word essay, two teacher letters. SAT/ACT optional.

flagshipSource.title: International Relations major: minutes from the UN district, with guest speakers and field trips to Geneva agencies

programmes.name: Finance
programmes.about: From basic finance to advanced investments and financial management, for careers in banking, financial services and international organizations, with course visits to banks, insurers and bodies such as the WTO.
programmes.ib: An IB Diploma with 24 points is the estimated minimum; predicted grades are enough for a provisional offer, and IB results can earn up to 32 credits.
programmes.selectionNote: Rolling review by an admissions committee, about 10 days after your file is complete: transcript, a 300-400-word essay, two teacher letters. SAT/ACT optional.

flagshipSource.title: Finance major: Geneva has more than 3,200 finance-related companies and 92 banks; course visits include the WTO

programmes.name: Computer Science
programmes.about: Software development, algorithms and data structures, operating systems and networks, with maths and hands-on training. An emphasis in cybersecurity adds network security, ethical hacking and defence.
programmes.ib: An IB Diploma with 24 points is the estimated minimum; predicted grades are enough for a provisional offer, and IB results can earn up to 32 credits.
programmes.selectionNote: Rolling review by an admissions committee, about 10 days after your file is complete: transcript, a 300-400-word essay, two teacher letters. SAT/ACT optional.

flagshipSource.title: Computer Science major: maths, hands-on training and a cybersecurity emphasis; Walker School of Business & Technology

faculties.name: College of Humanities and Social Sciences
faculties.line: Home of International Relations in Geneva. No entry subjects are set; Geneva admits you to the campus, not the college.

faculties.name: College of Science and Health
faculties.line: Home of the Psychology degrees in Geneva. No entry subjects are set; Geneva admits you to the campus, not the college.

faculties.name: George Herbert Walker School of Business & Technology
faculties.line: Home of Business, Finance and Computer Science in Geneva. No entry subjects are set; Geneva admits you to the campus, not the college.

notes: Admission is rolling; first-year students normally start in late August, with October and January starts possible in some cases.
Predicted IB grades are enough for a provisional decision; final IB results are needed for final admission and credit transfer.
You do not have to declare your major when you arrive.
